title: filter fade
system_instruction_addendum: FILTER FADE ADDENDUM: The color filter sweeps both extremes. Pulling left thins to high-pass; pushing right narrows to low-pass. The filter sounds like rising water.

tutor_speak.text: the filter knob lives above each channel strip. center is open; sweep left and you lose the bass, sweep right and you lose the highs.
sweep deck a's filter knob to one extreme and back to center.

hints.text: the filter sits just above the eq stack on deck a.
turn it past twelve o'clock and listen to the sound thin.
sweep deck a's filter knob in either direction.
